name: LONDONENCLOSURE
description:
## Description

"A 2-way speaker system equipped with DECCA ribbon tweeter.A cone type woofer is installed in the low range.This unit is a newly designed woofer to match the ribbon tweeter with a short voice coil made of aluminum to eliminate distortion caused by driving force.A ribbon type tweeter is installed in the high range.The ribbon type consists of an extremely thin (a fraction of a hair) aluminum foil ribbon wrapped around the center of a strong magnetic gap. This ribbon is a kind of voice coil, also considered a diaphragm. The ribbon type has only an extremely thin and massive ribbon that moves, and since the ribbon itself vibrates, it has excellent transient characteristics and enables clear high-frequency playback.The enclosure has a cheek finish.There was a special stand sold separately."

name: DK30
description:
## Description

"A ribbon type tweeter unit that is dynamic but does not have a voice coil.The interior is simple and consists of an ultra-thin aluminum ribbon, approximately 6mm wide and 8cm long, suspended in the middle of a strong magnetic gap. The ribbon is a type of voice coil designed to move simultaneously as a diaphragm.This causes an audio current to flow through the ribbon, causing the speaker to oscillate spontaneously according to the frequency and intensity of the signal.The horn section is cast in light alloy."

"Larger than DK30, wide range ribbon type speaker unit.The horn section is cast in light alloy.There was a cross-over network as an option sold separately."

name: LONDONINTERNATIONALARM
description:
## Description

"Oil dump type tone arm with one point support system.The arm is supported by a highly sensitive one point support system using a jewel with less bearing friction.The Inside Four Scan Seller uses the repulsive force of the magnet and ideally cancels the inside force which changes depending on the needle pressure and the position of the cartridge on the record board.The arm support part contains 3magnets, and the arm itself is lifted from the board by the repulsive action of the magnets, reducing vibration to the arm.With a built-in level in the head shell, it is possible to more accurately adjust the balance of the arm in the horizontal and vertical directions, which was previously done by eye measurement.It is designed so that the adjustment of lateral balance and needle pressure can be done more easily than the old type."
